 It wasn't pretty but Lakers showed they can work around Austin Reaves' absence 
 A narrow escape is still an escape! By Svyatoslav Rovenchuk | Nov 15, 2026, 7:18 PM EST Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Reddit Copy Article Add us as a preferred source Nov 1, 2026; Los Angeles, California, USA; Los Angeles Lakers guard Austin Reaves (15) reacts on the sideline with forward Jake LaRavia (12) after a foul is called against him against the Toronto Raptors during the second half at Crypto.com Arena. Mandatory Credit: Jonathan Hui-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Exactly how many games the Los Angeles Lakers are expected to be without Austin Reaves due to his heel injury is still unclear. What is clear, by contrast, is they have players ready to step up in his absence. The Lakers secured their eighth win in a row overall, even if this one was a touch ugly.
--> Exactly how many games the Los Angeles Lakers are expected to be without Austin Reaves due to his heel injury is still unclear. What is clear, by contrast, is they have players ready to step up in his absence. The Lakers secured their eighth win in a row overall, even if this one was a touch ugly.
 The Lakers marched into the fourth quarter with a 24-point lead. That advantage had been as large as 31 at one point of the night. They flirted a little too hard with letting go of the wheel down the stretch, but ultimately came away with a tough 131-123 win over the Phoenix Suns on Sunday.
--> The Lakers marched into the fourth quarter with a 24-point lead. That advantage had been as large as 31 at one point of the night. They flirted a little too hard with letting go of the wheel down the stretch, but ultimately came away with a tough 131-123 win over the Phoenix Suns on Sunday.
 Luka Doncic was brilliant, but everyone expected as much. Even with a couple of colder shooting stretches, Doncic still finished with 43 points, on 13-of-28 from the field, and nine assists. What was impressive about this one was the supporting cast doing their jobs around the Slovenian superstar.
--> Luka Doncic was brilliant, but everyone expected as much. Even with a couple of colder shooting stretches, Doncic still finished with 43 points, on 13-of-28 from the field, and nine assists. What was impressive about this one was the supporting cast doing their jobs around the Slovenian superstar.
 Each Lakers starter finished this contest with double digit points. Quentin Grimes led those efforts with 22 points. However, Walker Kessler (14), Jake LaRavia (12), and Matisse Thybulle (12) all chipped in supplementary scoring too. Throw in Collin Sexton's 16 points off the bench as well and Los Angeles had enough to get them over the finish line to complete a perfect road trip.
--> Each Lakers starter finished this contest with double digit points. Quentin Grimes led those efforts with 22 points. However, Walker Kessler (14), Jake LaRavia (12), and Matisse Thybulle (12) all chipped in supplementary scoring too. Throw in Collin Sexton's 16 points off the bench as well and Los Angeles had enough to get them over the finish line to complete a perfect road trip.
 Lakers depth did just enough to cover up for Austin Reaves being out
--> Lakers depth did just enough to cover up for Austin Reaves being out
 Reaves is one of the best players at his position. His efficient and malleable scoring brings a ton of value. As does his playmaking. Anytime you are missing a guy of his caliber from the lineup, it takes a village to make up for that absence.
--> Reaves is one of the best players at his position. His efficient and malleable scoring brings a ton of value. As does his playmaking. Anytime you are missing a guy of his caliber from the lineup, it takes a village to make up for that absence.
 That is what the Lakers got in this one.
--> That is what the Lakers got in this one.
 Another uncomfortable fourth quarter will be a worrisome issue for JJ Redick to address with the team moving forward. However, for at least one game, the Lakers can rest easy knowing they brought it home in spite of those struggles and their star being out.
--> Another uncomfortable fourth quarter will be a worrisome issue for JJ Redick to address with the team moving forward. However, for at least one game, the Lakers can rest easy knowing they brought it home in spite of those struggles and their star being out.
 Even when it got close, the supporting cast made timely plays to slow the bleeding just enough. A late offensive rebound and triple from Grimes helped ice this one. Los Angeles needed a more aggressive version of him and the $60 million wing delivered.
--> Even when it got close, the supporting cast made timely plays to slow the bleeding just enough. A late offensive rebound and triple from Grimes helped ice this one. Los Angeles needed a more aggressive version of him and the $60 million wing delivered.
 Assuming Reaves' injury is as mild as Redick suggested earlier this week, the Lakers just survived the toughest opponent during this stretch of games their star guard is expected to miss. That should provide a boost of confidence for the next few without AR15 playing.
